# Stage 2 integration on a single HDD: every file-system operation issues
# block requests, which the disk-arm scheduler (SSTF) serves when the
# command ends. With io_defer on, requests from several commands pile up
# and are served together by io_flush.
io_trace on
mkdir /logs
create /logs/app.log --size 10KB
write_file /logs/app.log "New record"
io_defer on
create /logs/a.txt "first"
create /logs/b.txt "second"
io_queue
io_flush
